name: trae-java-navigator
description: Java symbol navigation and real-time diagnostics for Trae agents via JDT LS (LSP).

interface.shortDescription: Find Java symbols and real-time compiler errors
interface.longDescription: An MCP server that talks to the Eclipse JDT language server. Agents can find class/method/field locations, jump to definitions, find references, read hovers and query real-time Java diagnostics without running Maven.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find the Java symbol I mention and show its real-time compiler errors.
